edition_kicker: THE WORLD IN ONE DAY · 11:45 UTC EDITION
deck: COP31 stalls in Antalya · Five Houthi missiles downed in Saudi Arabia · M6.8 Timor & M6.7 Peru quakes · Bitcoin two-year low · England record at MCG

stats.label: COP31 climate talks in overtime, no deal
Houthi missiles downed over Riyadh & Jizan
Banda Sea quake off Timor-Leste, 09:42 UTC
India Day 3 stumps in NZ; Rahul 136, Gill 98
All safe after Air Niugini Davao diversion

hero.headline: COP31 climate talks deadlocked past deadline
hero.summary: Negotiations ran past Friday's close after draft 2 dropped fossil-fuel phase-out text; France, the EU and Panama push back as a third draft is awaited.

hero.headline: Five Houthi missiles downed over Saudi Arabia
hero.summary: The Saudi-led coalition says air defenses destroyed three ballistic missiles over Riyadh and two over Jizan early Saturday after phone alerts woke residents.

hero.headline: M6.8 quake strikes Banda Sea off Timor-Leste
hero.summary: Deep tremor hits 103 km NE of Lospalos and shakes Darwin, Australia, hours after a separate M6.7 quake rocked central Peru; no tsunami or deaths reported.

cards.headline: Iran claims US MQ-9 downed over Hormuz
cards.summary: IRGC says a new air-defense system shot down a US Reaper drone; Washington has not confirmed it.

cards.headline: Zelenskyy calls Putin 'killer'; 52 hurt in strike
cards.summary: Ukraine leader rebukes Trump's remark as a double-tap strike kills a 7-year-old and paramedic.

cards.headline: Bitcoin falls to 2-year low, $2.4B wiped
cards.summary: BTC drops below $57k ($55.8k low; $58.2k live) amid AI-stock rout; ether slides 5.4% to $1,653.

cards.headline: Nations aim for AI weapon rules by 2028
cards.summary: UN delegates agree to elaborate autonomous-weapons rules by 2028, without a binding treaty yet.

cards.headline: Anthropic staffer claims AI Riemann proof
cards.summary: Mathematician Levent Alpöge says Claude built a Lean proof of the 167-year problem; unverified.

cards.headline: Air Niugini 767 diverts after fire alert
cards.summary: Hong Kong–PNG flight lands safely past midnight; 137 passengers and 9 crew evacuate unhurt.

cards.headline: Rahul's 136 puts India 118 ahead in NZ
cards.summary: First Indian opener with Test tons in all 4 SENA nations; Gill makes 98 before stumps.

cards.headline: Verstappen takes pole as Antonelli penalized
cards.summary: Champion Antonelli sets fastest lap but takes 5-place engine penalty; race runs tonight.
